_comment: Generated by demo-site/scripts/capture.ts — do not hand-edit the measured
fields. `text` and `blurb` are editorial; route, basis, operation,
presentation and recorded latency all come from the captured envelope, so
a label can never contradict the answer it sits beside (spec_v013 §5.1).

questions.text: How many doors are in this model?
questions.blurb: An exact count, not an estimate. Vector search cannot count; this is bound to a real SQL aggregate over the model.

questions.text: Break down the elements by IFC class.
questions.blurb: A grouped distribution — the one answer here the panel renders as a chart rather than a table.

questions.text: Describe the walls in this model.
questions.blurb: A qualitative question, so semantic ranking runs — but strictly inside the SQL scope, never as a substitute for it.
